newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Repsol to buy Argentina's Bridas - papers.
newsitem.headline: Repsol to buy Argentina's Bridas - papers.

text.p: Spain's Repsol is close to completing a $1 billion deal to buy Argentine oil and gas firm Bridas Energy Corp, newspapers reported Tuesday.
Clarin and La Nacion said the negotiations in New York would yield an imminent announcement. Clarin reported that an agreement in principle was signed on the weekend.
La Nacion, quoting unidentified Bridas sources, said Mobil Corp had linked up with Repsol to buy a stake in the private Argentine energy firm.
Bridas officials were unavailable immediately for comment.
Bridas, controlled by Argentina's Bulgheroni family, has said it is looking for a strategic partner to expand its international business.

Bridas set up a joint venture with Turkmenistan in 1992 to develop the huge Yashlar gas field in the eastern part of the country, which has estimated reserves of 27 trillion cubic feet and 165 million barrels of liquid hydrocarbons.
It also signed a deal to upgrade Kazakhstan's gas pipeline system, which forms part of the former Soviet network and carries Turkmen gas to Russia's export routes and on to Western Europe.
